name: Subsidy Enhancements
summary: Countdowns: time left on subsidy offers and rewards, and colour-coded rings on subsidy notifications
description:
Improvements to subsidies. The feature can be turned off in the mod's Settings (the gear next to the mod when choosing a game's mods). Settings also has a Logging switch, off by default, that writes the mod's messages to the game log (stdout.txt) for bug reports.

Countdowns: the game shows a subsidy's time left only while the subsidy is in progress. An offer stays open for about six months before it is withdrawn, and a fulfilled subsidy's reward runs for a set time (2x income on the supplying lines or the connection for five years), but the game shows neither time left. With this mod both show as a bar, drawn like the game's countdown for an accepted subsidy: an offer's time left to accept in its Subsidy Available notification and in its window, under Decline and Accept; a reward's time left in its Subsidy Effect Active notification and in its window. The calendar line on an offer still shows the time you get to fulfil it once accepted.

In the notification list, every subsidy's tile then has a countdown ring around its icon (the game draws one only while a subsidy is in progress), colour-coded by phase: white for an offer, yellow while in progress, green while the reward runs.

Only the display is changed: subsidies, their timing and their rewards stay as the game sets them. The mod saves nothing with your game, so it can be removed at any time.
